event_name: Papal bull Summis desiderantes affectibus issued
significance: Pope Innocent VIII issued Summis desiderantes affectibus, authorizing Heinrich Kramer's inquisitorial activity in Germany against heresy and witchcraft. Kramer incorporated the bull as a preface to the Malleus Maleficarum (1487), giving the work apparent papal endorsement — a misrepresentation scholars have since documented. The bull addressed specific personnel complaints about obstruction of Kramer's inquisitorial work and did not constitute a theological endorsement of the Malleus's contents.
source_method: Primary source: Summis desiderantes affectibus (December 5, 1484); analysis in Christopher Mackay, The Hammer of Witches (2009)
